title: Console app management still offers "Edit with AI", which opens the retired build agent (build retirement, cloud#5024)
body:
epic:#5024#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPTfYJJKJmzZ3By7a7

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task (build retirement epic objectstack-ai/cloud#5024; maintainer 2026-11-26: build is closed and its UI is to be deleted) · Source: contract review S2 on objectstack-ai/objectstack#37720 (comment 7206932534).
Grade: p2 · area:ai · domain:ui · Task · evidence: read (PR #37720 head 18cec5f4)

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：控制台「应用管理」页还有一个不受开关控制的「用 AI 编辑」按钮，点开的是已退役的 build agent。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Current state
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx:691` draws an ungated "Edit with AI" button that opens `{ agent: 'build', packageId }`. objectstack-ai/objectstack#37720 removed the build chat frontend; this entry point was outside its scope and is listed in its Acceptance notes.

## Do
1. Premise: re-read the line on current main; confirm no ask path depends on it.
2. Remove the button and any now-dead handler, labels and tests.

## Acceptance
- No console entry opens `agent: 'build'` (exact-name grep over `ui/apps/console`); app management page renders; affected tests green.
